about_the_game:
NeoRun is a fast-paced first-person parkour game that tests your reflexes and movement mastery. Run, jump, wallrun, climb, and swing through stylish environments without losing momentum. Every death is a lesson. Every run is a chance for greatness — and now, every motion has a pulse.

Adaptive Pulse is the dynamic 3D music system of NeoRun — the game adapts its soundtrack in real time based on how you move. Start slow, pick up the pace, and feel the rhythm pulse with your momentum. Whether you're wallrunning, grappling, or sprinting through danger, the audio evolves alongside you. With full Steam Audio integration, every sound lives in true 3D space, surrounding you as you run.

🎮 Key Features:

  • Fluid Movement System: Slide, crouch, jump, wallrun, climb, and grapple — all designed to keep your momentum alive.

  • Adaptive Pulse: delivers immersive real-time music transitions based on how you move. Walk, run, or sprint — each state smoothly blends into its own musical layer, preserving position, rhythm, and ambience. It uses Steam Audio’s spatial engine for true 3D directionality and environmental effects

  • Stylized Visuals: Each map features a unique color palette, lighting setup, and post-processing effects for immersive atmosphere.

  • Cinematic Feedback: Visual effects like chromatic aberration, exposure shifts, and saturation pulses enhance your sense of speed.

  • Responsive Audio Design: Hear your every move with custom audio feedback — footsteps, jumps, grapples, slides, and more.

  • Time-Based Challenge: Finish as fast as possible. Track your timer, deaths, and velocity in real time.

  • Dynamic HUD: See your speed, altitude, and time clearly with an in-world heads-up display.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Supports keyboard + mouse and gamepad.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 3.1 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600x 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Supports keyboard + mouse and gamepad.
